title: Swiss Grid
line: Black sans on white, one signal red, hard cuts on the beat: information as design.
line_zh: 白底黑色无衬线字，一抹信号红，踩点硬切：信息即设计。
prompt: Swiss grid style: heavy black sans on pure white, one signal red for the key word, flush-left lines, letters that rise crisp, hard cuts and straight pushes on the beat, a clean tech pulse bed with ticks. No textures.
prompt_zh: 瑞士网格风格：纯白底上的粗黑无衬线字，关键词用信号红，左对齐，字母利落上升的字效，踩点硬切与直推转场，干净的科技律动配乐加滴答声。不要纹理。
essence: The grid is the hero: big flush-left sans type, strict alignment and one red that marks the point. Motion is exact and short; nothing floats.

not.difference: Editorial Print is serif on textured paper; Swiss Grid is sans on clean white with no texture.
Kinetic Poster slams type on a loud ground with overshoot; Swiss Grid stays on white and never overshoots.

palette.logic: pure white, near-black ink, ONE signal red; greys only for secondary lines

camera.expresses: a snap to the next grid cell
a straight push that keeps the grid square

sound.foley: ticks and clicks on the grid lines

signature_features.text: heavy sans (Manrope 800) flush left, crisp char rises, the name tracking in tight
white ground, black ink at 19:1, red accent at 4.9:1 (contrast.py)
hard cuts and straight pushes only; no dissolves, leaks or glitches
a tech pulse bed with UI ticks
every line starts on the same left edge

demo.lint: mp lint 96.6/100, 52 PASS, 4 WARN, 0 FAIL, 0 INFO, 13 N/A
demo.made_by: Claude Code (Opus 5.5) through mp plan --style, mp new, mp render (HyperFrames, CRF 18) and mp lint; 0 human rounds; the same placeholder copy in every style

honesty: The demo is one run on a neutral placeholder subject (a fictional late-night library, labelled placeholder). The same prompt makes a different film on every run.
